headline: Resort-Style Private Pool & Courtyard
alt_text: Ivory, navy and gold Villa Fabulosa graphic reading “Resort-Style Private Pool & Courtyard.” A dusk photograph shows a blue-lit rectangular pool with white in-pool loungers, navy poolside loungers and a modern white two-storey villa with glass balconies. The footer reads “Temecula Wine Country” and “Explore VillaFabulosa.com.”
generation_method: Built-in image_gen tool; one generation call; opaque PNG copied into workspace without code image editing or resizing.
prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: ONE finished vertical Pinterest pin, 2:3 portrait, 1024 by 1536 pixels.
Primary request: Create a polished Villa Fabulosa campaign graphic by faithfully placing the actual property photograph from image 1 into an editorial ivory/navy/gold layout matching image 2's styling.
Input images: Image 1 (villa-fabulosa-13-14-pool.webp) is the actual property photograph and EDIT TARGET for the photo panel; preserve its visual content. Image 2 (pin-001.png) is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: typography, spacing, brand placement, ivory/navy/gold colors and CTA treatment. Do not reuse image 2's pool photograph, architecture or original headline.
Composition: Warm ivory top and bottom bands, restrained thin champagne-gold dividers, centered spaced uppercase navy brand at top, large elegant high-contrast navy serif headline on balanced lines, full-width landscape photograph panel in the middle, clean lower ivory band with navy sans-serif location subline and a navy rectangular CTA with thin gold border and white sans-serif text. Give the headline breathing room, clear mobile-size readability and safe margins. Preserve the source landscape panel rather than inventing a tall photo extension. The photo should prominently show the blue-lit pool, courtyard and white two-storey villa.
Text (verbatim, exactly four strings, no other copy):
"VILLA FABULOSA"
"Resort-Style Private Pool & Courtyard"
"Temecula Wine Country"
"Explore VillaFabulosa.com"
Photographic invariants: Retain image 1's actual white modern two-storey building on the right, all window and door geometry, glass balcony, covered seating area, pool and raised spa geometry, white in-pool loungers, navy poolside loungers, patio paving, lawn, background fence and original purple/blue dusk sky. Keep the same camera angle, perspective, original lighting, furniture count and positions. Do not invent structures, change pool shape, add amenities or alter landscaping. Do not add people. Do not brighten, recolor or replace the sky. Treat the photograph as a faithful rectangular insert with typography outside the property area.
Avoid: Photo from the style reference, generated photo extensions, redesigned buildings, extra text, rankings, prices, guarantees, seals, awards, watermarks, logos not supplied, people, collages, alternate variants or montage. Produce exactly ONE cohesive opaque graphic.
review: Inspected the actual property photograph and approved pin-001 style reference before generation, then inspected the saved final PNG. All four required text strings are correct, readable and within margins. The white two-storey villa, window/balcony arrangement, pool and spa, white in-pool loungers, navy seating, paving and lawn remain recognizable and consistent with the source. No people or invented amenities are visible. The generated panel is reframed slightly and its pink clouds are more prominent and textured than the original dusk sky despite the preservation instruction. It is a generated/composited rendition of the actual photograph, not a pixel-identical pasted crop.
